changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'RedGate.get_recent_audits') AND type in (N'P', N'PC')) BEGIN DROP PROCEDURE RedGate.get_recent_audits END

changeSet.author: redgate
changeSet.sql:
CREATE PROCEDURE RedGate.get_recent_audits @p_days INT, @p_min_customer_id INT = NULL AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- Return recent audit records based on days and optional customer filter SELECT AuditID, CustomerID, Note, CreatedAt FROM RedGate.FeedbackAudit WHERE CreatedAt > DATEADD(DAY, -@p_days, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()) AND (@p_min_customer_id IS NULL OR CustomerID >= @p_min_customer_id) ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC, AuditID DESC; END
